title: ARCH↔DATA-001: Telemetry Schema + Data-Flow Topology
description: Architect supplies the telemetry schema, data-flow topology, sampling/payload budgets, and edge-buffering behavior; Data returns ingestion feasibility, schema-evolution constraints, and storage/throughput limits that may feed back into payload design. Grounded in EMBEDDED_SYSTEMS_ARCHITECT_SKILL §6.6. The per-field telemetry schema is owned by DATA's Git-based schema registry (resolved by schema_version), not duplicated here.

schema_version.description: SemVer of the device telemetry schema (registered in DATA's Git registry).

payload_budget_bytes.description: Per-message payload budget in bytes (LoRaWAN-constrained uplink).

ingestion_feedback.description: DATA→ARCH: feasibility + limits feeding back into payload design.

schema_evolution_constraints.description: Backward-compatibility / migration constraints on schema evolution.

storage_throughput_limit_writes_per_s.description: Time-series write-throughput ceiling in writes/s (target SCALE-5: 50,000 writes/s).

schema_change.description: Schema-change coordination (breaking changes require an ADR with the Architect as approver).

x-macp.tier_rationale: Routine schema/topology alignment is agent-autonomous. A backward-incompatible schema change escalates to an ADR (Architect approver) — Tier-1/2 — per the FW↔DATA schema-change process.
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (schema definition at planning; pipeline-integration checkpoints; schema-change ADR reviews)
confirm_conditions: telemetry_schema carries a SemVer schema_version, a data_flow_topology, and a payload_budget_bytes
any schema_change with backward_compatible = false carries an adr_ref
reject_conditions: backward-incompatible schema change without an ADR (Architect approver)
ingestion declared feasible while a throughput limit is exceeded
counter_conditions: payload budget conflicts with the required sampling rate over a LoRaWAN uplink — request a sampling/aggregation trade study
schema-evolution constraint ambiguous — request the migration path before sign-off
